declarations.docstring: Sends a tensor of a polynomial with a module element to its finitely supported coefficient family.
Builds a polynomial tensor expression from a finitely supported family indexed by natural numbers.
The map from polynomial tensors to finitely supported coefficient families is bijective.
The coefficient-family map on polynomial tensors is injective.
Converting a polynomial tensor to coefficients and back recovers the original tensor.
Converting a finitely supported coefficient family to a polynomial tensor and back recovers the family.
Rewrites a finite sum of iterated linear-map actions using its zeroth term and shifted coefficient sum.
A finitely supported family satisfying a successor recurrence with a zero-preserving map is zero.
The module structure obtained by restricting polynomial scalars along constants agrees with the standard one.
The polynomial-module endomorphism given by multiplication by `X` minus a mapped linear action is injective.
